added: With Device Sync on, your new figures, your terms and your shorthands for your new figures now sync to your other devices, once every device connected to your store has this version of the app. Until then they stay on each device, and Device Sync names the device holding them back.

changed: `SyncCapabilityPolicy.build` now advertises `glossary.v2` alongside `glossary.v1`, so the user's own terms and figures (`glossaryEntry` records of kind `term` or `customFigure`) and the `user_figure_shorthands` setting publish once every attached device advertises it (#1023).
